title: Draft Pocket CSV reader quoting and empty-field fixtures
capability: export import (kizuki.import-pocket); this packet is the pure CSV-cell reader only

findings.summary: RFC 4180 §2.6 would keep CR and LF as distinct bytes inside a quoted field. csv.ts:31 rewrites the whole buffer with /\r\n?/g before scanning, so a quoted CRLF becomes one LF (golden Q14).
findings.action: preserve; do not treat as a new defect in P078 unless the owner wants CRLF preserved inside quotes

findings.summary: RFC 4180 ABNF would treat a blank line as a record of one empty field. csv.ts:20-22 and :72-85 skip a line that never started a row. Quoted empty "" is kept as [""] (E7, E13, E15).
findings.action: preserve; existing csv.test.ts:38-42 already asserts the skip

findings.summary: csv.test.ts covers trailing empty a,b, and a,"", but not leading empty, consecutive middle empty, quoted-empty first/last/middle, empty file, newline-only, space-as-content, trailing empty at EOF, or Pocket-shaped five-cell empty tags at the parseCsv layer.
findings.action: P078 add cases from csv-reader.test.ts; do not duplicate csv.test.ts

findings.summary: This archive has no node_modules. cd /repo && bun test packages/connectors/test/csv.test.ts exits 1 with Cannot find module '@kizuki/core' from packages/connectors/src/errors.ts.
